name: Slack AI
desc: Search and summaries across your whole Slack history.
desc_zh: 跨整个工作区历史的搜索与总结
solves: One decision, three weeks back, buried in a thread nobody reads to the end. Slack AI recaps the channel and answers across the history.
solves_zh: 一个三周前的决定，埋在一串没人读到头的会话里。Slack AI 给出频道回顾，也能跨历史回答。
best_for: Answering “where did we land on this?” without scrolling back through a week.
best_for_zh: 回答「这个我们最后怎么定的？」，而不用往回翻一周的会话。
notes: 集成在 Slack 内的能力。来源：https://slack.com/features/ai
